title: 第1638章 绝对的实力压制第1637章 重伤帝塔
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
越是高阶丹药，效果越好，但丹毒也越重，就算是上品、极品丹药，也不可能将丹毒完全清除干净，一次直接服用两瓶丹药，怕是不等丹药效果滋养身体，先一步倒在丹毒的副作用之下。
可惜，帝塔没有看到苏星河倒下，反而他体表气息，正在以肉眼可见的速度，迅速恢复。
“你先放开帝塔首领！”
在苏星河服用丹药的功夫，祝青锋与女子巫族修士，有了决定，二人眉心诡异血色铭文印记，不再继续延伸，却也没有立刻收起，显然，仍旧处于戒备之中。
“好说，不过，要等帝塔首领答应了我的条件！”
苏星河笑着点头，嘴上做出让步，却并未将五行仙剑，从帝塔体内抽回来。
帝塔虽然身受重伤，但毕竟是能够施展出堪比化神镜的强大攻击，在不能保证万无一失的前提下，苏星河自然不会让步。
“什么条件？”
作为当事人的帝塔还未开口，祝青锋帮他问了出来。
“等一下！”
苏星河不急不缓的转过头，对着正在凝聚剑光，蓄势待发的封岳三人，笑道：
“封岳道友，你的太乙天道剑，锁定祝青锋！”
说罢，又侧头，看向大阵外苏忘机，问道：
“族老，你恢复的如何了？”
苏忘机先前独自对战一位巫族强者，虽然不能受伤，但催动法天象地神通，又催动属性融合之力，消耗丝毫不比苏星河低，听到苏星河突然问到自己，虽然有些意外，还是高声回道：
“恢复的七七八八，刚才那般威力的攻击，再施展一次，不成问题！”
“好！那劳烦族老，看住这位巫族女子道友！”
苏星河满意的点点头，目光有意无意的扫过祝青锋与巫族女修。
“你想要做什么！？”
祝青锋与巫族女修，脸色大变，原本已经收敛的气息，再次有了爆发的迹象。

“两位不要误会，接下来我要做的事，需要保证绝对安全，若是你们二人突然对苏某出手，苏某无法应对，只能让我的同伴为我护法了！”
见二人要炸毛，苏星河连忙开口安慰。
“你究竟要做什么？”
帝塔面色狰狞，只不过，与之前的阴狠不同，此时的狰狞，更多是因为痛苦。
“我都说了别急，先听我给三位......不对，是四位！”
苏星河视线在重伤的蓐苍刑身上扫过，语气略带玩味道：
“先听我给你们分析一下局势！”
见四人都没接话，苏星河继续道：
“如今帝塔道友重伤，可以说生死都在我的掌控之中！最重要的是，像刚才这般威力的攻击，我还能继续施展！”
说着，苏星河目光再次看向祝青锋。
content_en:
The higher the level of the elixir, the better the effect, but the more serious the erysipelas. Even top-grade elixirs cannot completely remove the erysipelas. If you take two bottles of elixirs at one time, you may not wait for the effects of the elixirs to nourish your body, and you may suffer from the side effects of the erysipelas first.
Unfortunately, Di Ta did not see Su Xinghe fall. Instead, the aura on his body was rapidly recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Let go of the leader of the Imperial Tower first!"
While Su Xinghe was taking the elixir, Zhu Qingfeng and the female witch cultivator made a decision. The strange blood-colored inscription mark between their eyebrows stopped extending, but they did not immediately put it away. Obviously, they were still on guard.
"It's easy to say, but I have to wait until the leader of the Imperial Tower agrees to my conditions!"
Su Xinghe nodded with a smile and made a concession, but did not withdraw the Five Elements Sword from the Imperial Tower.
Although Di Ta was seriously injured, he was still able to perform a powerful attack comparable to that of the Divine Transformation Mirror. Su Xinghe would not give in without guaranteeing that it would be foolproof.
"What conditions?"
Before Di Ta, the person involved, could speak, Zhu Qingfeng helped him ask.
"Wait a minute!"
Su Xinghe turned his head unhurriedly, facing Feng Yue and the others who were condensing sword light and getting ready to go, and said with a smile:
"Fellow Daoist Feng Yue, your Taiyi Tiandao Sword is locked on Zhu Qingfeng!"
After saying that, he turned his head again, looked at Su Wangji outside the formation, and asked:
"Elder, how are you recovering?"
Su Wangji had previously fought against a strong man from the Wu clan alone. Although he could not be injured, he activated the magic power of heaven, earth, and earth, and activated the power of attribute fusion. The consumption was no lower than that of Su Xinghe. When he heard Su Xinghe suddenly ask him, although he was a little surprised, he still replied loudly:
"After recovering, I can use the powerful attack just now. It won't be a problem if I use it again!"
"Okay! Elder of the troublesome clan, keep an eye on this female Taoist fellow from the Wu clan!"
Su Xinghe nodded with satisfaction and glanced at Zhu Qingfeng and the Witch Clan female cultivator intentionally or unintentionally.
"What do you want!?"
The faces of Zhu Qingfeng and the female cultivator from the Witch Clan changed drastically, and their auras that had been restrained showed signs of exploding again.
"Don't get me wrong, you two. What I am going to do next needs to be absolutely safe. If you two suddenly attack Su, Su will not be able to deal with it and will have to ask my companions to protect me!"
Seeing that the two of them were about to get angry, Su Xinghe quickly spoke to comfort them.
"What exactly are you going to do?"
Di Ta's expression was ferocious, but unlike the previous ruthlessness, the ferocity at this time was more due to pain.
"I told you not to worry, just listen to the three of you first... No, it's the four!"
Su Xinghe's eyes swept over the seriously injured Lu Cangxing, and his tone was slightly playful:
"Let me analyze the situation for you first!"
Seeing that none of the four people answered, Su Xinghe continued:
"Now that fellow Taoist Emperor Pagoda is seriously injured, it can be said that life and death are under my control! The most important thing is that I can continue to use such a powerful attack like just now!"
After saying that, Su Xinghe looked at Zhu Qingfeng again.
